SELECT
                o.id AS OrderId,
                o.created_at AS CreatedAt,
                s.id AS StoreID,
                s.store_name AS StoreName,
                hol.action as HyperlocalAction,
                hol.updated_at as AcceptedAt
            FROM
                hyperlocal_order_log hol
					LEFT JOIN
				orders o ON o.id = hol.order_id
					LEFT JOIN
                stores s ON s.id = o.location_id
            WHERE
                hol.action = 'ACCEPTED'
                AND hol.updated_at >= '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                AND hol.updated_at <= '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
            GROUP BY o.id

SELECT 
                o.id AS OrderId,
                o.start_timeslot AS StartTimeslot,
                o.end_timeslot AS EndTimeslot,
                c.created_at AS DeliveredAt,
                CAST((TIMEDIFF(c.created_at, o.end_timeslot)) AS CHAR) AS TotalDelay
            FROM
                orders o
                    LEFT JOIN
                comments c ON c.order_id = o.id
            WHERE
                c.hl_status = 'finished'
                    AND c.created_at > o.end_timeslot
                    AND o.created_at >= '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                    AND o.created_at <= '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
            group by o.id

SELECT
                s.store_name AS StoreName,
                hlol.order_id AS OrderID,
                hlol.reason AS Reason,
                hlol.remark AS Comment,
				hlol.created_at AS ConvertedAt,
				hlol.new_order_id AS ConvertedOrderID
            FROM
                hyperlocal_to_online_order_logs hlol
                    LEFT JOIN
                stores s ON hlol.location_id = s.id
            WHERE
                hlol.created_at >= '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                    AND hlol.created_at <= '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
                    AND hlol.platform = 'CONVERT_ONLINE';

SELECT order_id, fd_ticket_id, created_at FROM hyperlocal_fd_logs 
                WHERE fd_ticket_status NOT IN ('CLOSED')
                AND created_at >= '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                AND created_at <= '2026-11-16 23:59:59';
